review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: complete local origin/main-to-head diff and prior review contracts
public WeChat focus, send, list, open, and action call paths
Accessibility target allowlisting and worker process identity
CLI dry-run, release preflight, tests, and stable developer docs
excluded_scope: real package and GitHub Release publication

decision.rationale: No open code finding remains, but the required exact-code public send_message smoke did not execute and current GitHub CI could not be observed because the local-action approval service had reached its usage limit.

summary: PRR-013 through PRR-016 are resolved in source and deterministic tests: public focus/send uses verified open_contact, explicit AX targets are identity-checked, row refs carry exact identity preconditions, and lists no longer advertise false continuation. Merge approval remains incomplete pending one authorized live send proof and current CI evidence.

change_map.change: Delegate focus_contact and send_message target switching to verified open_contact.
change_map.external_behavior: The requested chat is title-verified before any draft or submit.
change_map.validation: Call-path review and deterministic no-hotkey command-sequence tests.

change_map.change: Validate query/action target allowlists, infer configured bundles, and check target-app-only frontmost identity.
change_map.external_behavior: Explicit target requests cannot silently resolve to a different app.
change_map.validation: Positive configured-bundle tests, unallowlisted-target negatives, and worker source review.

change_map.change: Require exact row label preconditions and reject unlabeled rows before every action or coordinate path.
change_map.external_behavior: Stale or unverifiable row refs fail before pressing a different contact.
change_map.validation: Changed-label, matching-label, missing-label, and zero-command tests.

change_map.change: Expose visibleWindow mode, null continuation, and explicit token rejection.
change_map.external_behavior: Callers cannot loop over duplicate synthetic pages.
change_map.validation: No-token and supplied-token tests plus stable docs.

findings.title: Public focus_contact and send_message used an obsolete live path
findings.observation: The compatibility focus method now delegates to _open_contact, and send_message reaches that same verified target-switch path.
findings.trigger: Call focus_contact or send_message for a contact that must be selected.
findings.impact: The previous hotkey path could not focus the target on the reviewed WeChat client; the replacement uses the proven semantic path.

evidence.description: _focus_contact creates an open_contact child command and returns only after its verified result succeeds.
Focus, send, CLI, smoke, and root SDK tests assert accessibility_query/action/title verification with no global-search hotkey.

findings.remediation: Completed in code; retain one shared selector-backed contact-switch contract.
findings.verification: Deterministic tests pass. Exact-code live public send remains a merge-evidence gate because the authorized command did not execute.

findings.title: Target-app-only AX requests could select the wrong application
findings.observation: Query and action now validate explicit targets, infer configured bundle ids when present, and otherwise require the named target to be frontmost.
findings.trigger: Issue an AX query or action with target_app and no explicit bundle id.
findings.impact: The request no longer reads or mutates whichever unrelated application happens to be frontmost.

evidence.description: Configured-bundle positive and unallowlisted-target negative tests pass before worker execution.
Both worker scripts compare targetApp to the frontmost localized application name when no bundle is available.

findings.remediation: Completed: allowlist validation, configured bundle inference, and fail-closed name identity.
findings.verification: Computer-use package suite passes with 128 tests and one platform-conditional skip.

findings.title: Conversation-row actionRefs could press a reordered contact
findings.observation: Executable row refs require a concrete target label in labelIn, and all unlabeled row paths fail before backend or coordinate execution.
findings.trigger: Execute a stale changed-label row ref or pass an unlabeled framed AXRow to the click helper.
findings.impact: The operation fails instead of opening a different contact that now occupies the same path.

evidence.description: Missing identity, changed identity, matching identity, and unlabeled frame tests assert fail-closed behavior and zero backend calls when required.
Visible-contact opening executes the candidate's exact-identity actionRef while public element labels remain semantic.

findings.remediation: Completed: exact row precondition, pre-execution identity gate, and pre-coordinate missing-label rejection.
findings.verification: WeChat package suite passes with 123 tests.

findings.title: Visible-window lists returned continuation tokens that repeated page one
findings.observation: Both list paths return mode=visibleWindow and nextPageToken=null, while non-null input tokens fail before app-control work.
findings.trigger: Request a list with a caller-supplied continuation token or receive more visible rows than the requested limit.
findings.impact: Callers cannot enter an unbounded duplicate-page loop.

evidence.description: Tests cover visible-window hasMore with null continuation and pagination_not_supported with zero commands.
Stable API, package, migration, and WeChat docs now state the no-cursor contract.

findings.remediation: Completed: remove synthetic tokens and reject unsupported continuation input.
findings.verification: WeChat tests and exact-head release preflight pass.
